context:
Goal: the merge tool tells a lane its review result without spamming.
Problem (risk): after #3148, merge --reviewed posts a lane-mail marker and sends mail; a run on your computer should not mail lanes.
Based on (finding): reviewer finding 9 on #3148.
Departs from: main — main sends no lane mail; this adds mail from runner sessions only.

options.gain: No stray mail from a test or hand run.
options.how: merge --reviewed sends lane mail only in a batch-runner session; on your computer it prints "lane mail not sent".
options.label: Lane mail sends only from a batch-runner session (coordinator's pick)
options.lose: Your own run sends no mail.

options.how: merge --reviewed sends mail wherever it runs.
options.label: Lane mail sends from any session
options.lose: A hand run can mail a lane by mistake.

ref: coordinator 11:26 CST Nov 13; reviewer finding 9 on #3148

shown.label: Lane mail sends only from a batch-runner session (coordinator's pick)
Lane mail sends from any session

title: Send lane mail from merge --reviewed only in a batch-runner session?
why: The coordinator took this pick; it stands unless you choose b.
